south.subject_description: a young male janitor with brown hair and a red bandana, cream shirt and blue work overalls, holding a kitchen knife
south.initial_pose: mid-stride walking pose, legs apart, facing the camera, holding the knife in front of him with his arm bent
south.action_description: Strict front view the whole time: he keeps facing the camera, his face, chest and both shoulders stay turned toward the camera, and his body never turns sideways. He keeps walking forward in place at a steady pace the whole time and never stops: his legs keep striding alternately, knees lifting and boots stepping one after the other, exactly like a looping walk cycle. While his legs keep walking, only his knife arm attacks: one very quick, sharp downward stab with the knife in front of his body, toward the bottom of the image. His other arm stays close to his body. At the moment of the stab, a thin white streak appears along the blade's path in front of him. The streak vanishes at once, then he pulls the arm back into the starting guard, still walking, ending in the same mid-stride walking pose he started in. Only one stab. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down front view throughout the entire fluid animation.
